subcategory_text: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-in-transit are protected
informative_references: ISO/IEC 27001:2022: Clause 4.2(b), Clause 5.2, Annex A.5.3, Annex A.5.10, Annex A.5.13, Annex A.5.14, Annex A.5.15, Annex A.6.1 (+9 more)
implementation_examples: Use encryption, digital signatures, and cryptographic hashes to protect the confidentiality and integrity of network communications
Automatically encrypt or block outbound emails and other communications that contain sensitive data, depending on the data classification
Block access to personal email, file sharing, file storage services, and other personal communications applications and services from organizational systems and networks
Prevent reuse of sensitive data from production environments (e.g., customer records) in development, testing, and other non-production environments
assessment_objectives: Determine whether the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-in-transit are protected.
Determine whether activities are conducted to use encryption, digital signatures, and cryptographic hashes to protect the confidentiality and integrity of network communications.
Determine whether mechanisms ensure that automatically encrypt or block outbound emails and other communications that contain sensitive data, depending on the data classification.
Determine whether implementation outcomes are monitored, evaluated, and documented.
